## Spectral Iteration

_A Prismatic Journey thru the Beautiful Art of Fractals and Abstracts_

**San Jaya Prime**

_Beautiful and vivid fractal designs, hypnotic Mandelbrot spirals, and mysterious, blood-pumping abstracts. Every single page is another step forward into the spectrum. The journey is yours to take._

This 7" x 7" art book is the brainchild of yours truly -- internationally acclaimed and award-winning fractalist San Jaya Prime. These are the same designs you've seen bleeding across book covers, album art, video games, and as massive murals at resort hotels, all built on vivid colors wrapping tightly around the hard lines of sacred geometry.

This is the exact coordinate where cold math and raw nature violently collide on the shores of the infinite.

content.text:
## A Long Time Coming

I didn't just dump a bunch of images into a template and hit print. Beyond forging the actual fractals and abstracts breathing inside this book, I personally designed the cover and ruthlessly oversaw every inch of the layout -- the placement, the poetry, the quotes, all of it. This is my very first full-color book of fine art fractals and abstracts, and I am fiercely proud to drag this out into the light for the world to see.

_Spectral Iteration_ was birthed straight out of the _"Spectral Recursion"_ fractal series that I'd started dropping at the beginning of 2016. The response was absolute madness. After getting featured all over the map, I knew I had to pull them all together and bind them into a physical book.

Along the way, a ton of these pieces mutated into fine art clothing, cases, journals, and other gear across Redbubble ([link](https://www.redbubble.com/people/jayaprime/shop)) and others. The demand just keeps rising, and I've got more storefronts locked and loaded to meet it. But make no mistake -- this book right here? _It's only the beginning._

Massive gratitude to every single soul who rode with this series from the very first drop.

## Spectral Iteration: Deluxe Edition

There are two very special deluxe editions in the wild. They're about the size of a vinyl record case, with even more content added into them. One was owned by my friend Doctor Dillon, who took it with him to the Halloween festivities at the Chapel of Sacred Mirrors ([COSM](https://www.cosm.org/)). It's funny how small Burning Man makes the world. Alex + Allyson Grey had their own camp a few streets up from my first camp at Burning Man, Camp Mystic, then their camp folded into Mystic with "The Intentheon" of 2010 and 2011, where I was DJing atop the scaffolding. Then my second camp at the burn, Indie Rogue Burners, is where I met Doctor Dillon himself... who just five years later would be taking my book to where it now rests at COSM with the Greys. The only other copy of the deluxe edition came down to Costa Rica with me in 2025, where it now resides. While expensive to produce, this larger, high-detailed size and added content makes it an incredible experience to hold in your hands.

### With Love + Gratitude

I have to shout out so much gratitude to all those who bought copies and left reviews. I've read every single one of them and these words mean more than you know: Yvonne Licciardi, Tristan Skybreak, Peter J Dillon, Lili, Alex Allman, Nathan Otto, Mark Mandel, Ariel, David Mizne, and LAQHA! Then a huge shout out to all the fans, as well, who helped make the original _"Spectral Recursion"_ series such a big hit!

Many of the fractals featured in the book also appear here on this site, such as "[Heart of the Rose](heart-of-the-rose)", "[Nocturne of Scorpio](nocturne-of-scorpio)", and of course "[Mother of Pearl](mother-of-pearl)" (just to name a few).
